issues: 27336, 27337, 27342, 27343: The explanation describes the 112 single-response-center routing model without geographic qualification. The cited Ministry limits this model to regions where it is active; elsewhere the 112 service is answered by Carabinieri operations centers (https://prefettura.interno.gov.it/it/prefetture/biella/112-nue-numero-unico-emergenza). Qualify the organizational description while preserving emergency calling guidance.
